paragraphs: Decorated war veteran Will Hinchcliff arranges a fake alley mugging so he can disarm the supposed attacker and prove his courage to his wife Judy. The practical joke collapses into real violence, leaving Judy and the man hired to play the mugger dead. As police and friends try to make sense of the disaster, Will's guilt exposes a deeper motive: he has never reconciled surviving the war while so many of his friends died, and happiness has felt like something he did not deserve.
